threats.title: Unauthorised access to repo
threats.description: Unauthorized access is when a person gains access to a system or data without the owner's permission.
threats.mitigation:
Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) and role-based access control (RBAC).
Regularly audit access logs.
Enforce the principle of least privilege.

threats.title: Injection of malicious code in CI Pipeline Execution
threats.description: An attacker can modify the pipeline process, inject malicious code, or access sensitive data within the pipeline.
threats.mitigation:
Enforce access controls.
Update the CI tools to patch known vulnerabilities. 
Use security monitoring to detect unusual activities.

threats.title: Container image tampering in Docker Hub
threats.description: Attackers can insert backdoors that may later be used to gain unauthorized access to systems.
threats.mitigation: Regularly audit and scan images for vulnerabilities.

threats.title: Injection of malicious code through dependencies
threats.description: Attackers can Inject malicious code into legitimate software packages that developers frequently use.
threats.mitigation:
Implement automated dependency scanning tools to detect vulnerabilities or suspicious changes in dependencies.
Verify dependencies when possible.
